scope: Generated test coverage for existing AC1032 writer output; no production behavior or support claim changed.

normative_basis.document: Open Design Specification for .dwg files, v5.4.1

sections.requirement: AC1032 appends three zero-valued Int16 values to the end of AcDb:AuxHeader.
Defines the AuxHeader record and raw version values AC1027=31 and AC1032=33.

generated_control.input: In-memory AC1027 and AC1032 DWG outputs, each decoded using its matching reader class.
assertions: AuxHeader section exists and decodes for both versions.
Raw version words are 31 for AC1027 and 33 for AC1032.
AC1032 AuxHeader payload is exactly six bytes longer than AC1027.
The final six AC1032 AuxHeader bytes are all zero.

evidence_limits: Test exercises locally generated writer output and the matching libdxfrw reader; it is not an independent producer result.
No native CAD application or full test suite was run.
No DWG/DXF support claim is promoted.
